title: Moroni Writes More
summary: After abridging the account of the people of Jared, Moroni writes more than he had expected to, hoping his words may be of worth to the Lamanites in a future day. He does not make himself known to them lest they destroy him.

explicit_facts.text: Moroni had finished abridging the account of the people of Jared and had supposed he would write no more.
Moroni does not make himself known to the Lamanites lest they destroy him.
Moroni writes a few more things, hoping they may be of worth to the Lamanites in some future day, according to the will of the Lord.

unspecified_visual_details: Moroni's appearance, age, clothing, writing materials, surroundings, and exact location are not stated.

narration.text: I write a few more things

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The first-person narration is Moroni's. The account of the people of Jared has already been abridged; these verses do not narrate that work as a present event.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict Lamanites present or discovering Moroni.
Do not invent a specific hiding place, pursuit, or writing materials.
Do not depict the earlier abridgment as happening at the same time as this writing.
